results.title: The hot take about agent budgets nobody wants to say out loud
results.content: Agent budgets are backwards: teams spend on model calls before they spend on measurement. That's backwards. Measurement first, calls second.

results.title: Why your AI demo dies in week three
results.content: Week three is when the demo meets real inputs. The fix is boring: constrain inputs, measure outputs, rehearse failures.

results.title: Evaluation debt is the new technical debt
results.content: Every unscored change compounds into evaluation debt. Teams that pay it down early ship faster later.
